text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on Walter Street and on surrounding neighbourhood streets. Our office has received a petition from residents in support of the installation of speed humps on Walter Street. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Walter Street between Kingston Road and Lyall Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Walter Street, between Kingston Road and Lyall Avenue, generally as shown on the Attachment 2 to the letter (February 18, 2026) from Councillor Brad Bradford.
